facts.value: The information regarding the TOEFL test refers to the internet-based test. Please note that a 'MyBest Scores' result is not accepted.

facts.value: Please take the TOEFL at a test center, as many of our partner universities do not accept the TOEFL Home Edition.

facts.value: No proof through the Abitur certificate is accepted unless it is explicitly stated in the certificate that you have unrestricted access to foreign universities with your language acquisition.

facts.value: If B2 is specified, you can apply with proof from the department (B2.1 or B2.2) or an equivalent DAAD test.

facts.value: Please note that changes to university-specific information on language requirements are not excluded and check the information regularly.

facts.value: If you do not speak the native language of the destination country, we recommend that you acquire basic knowledge of the respective language where possible. This is not a requirement for application!

facts.value: If multiple language requirements are listed (e.g., B2/TOEFL/IELTS), these are to be understood as alternatives, meaning you only need to submit proof of one of them.

facts.value: Please check the course offerings in your desired language beyond the information provided here and be aware that some universities may offer only a few English-language courses or that only master's courses can be chosen.
